tours.name: Post and Discover Clip
tours.outcome: A short clip is published and discoverable by community members in the feed

steps.title: Upload video with caption (the clip becomes published). Rule: Clip must be a short video with a caption
Browse community feed and view clip (the clip becomes published). Rule: Only visible non-hidden clips are shown

tours.name: Engage with Community
tours.outcome: Social interactions and connections are established, notifying the creator

steps.title: Like clip or comment on clip (the interaction becomes recorded). Rule: Interactions require signed-in member account
Follow clip creator (the follow becomes active). Rule: Member cannot follow themselves
Receive interaction notification (the notification becomes delivered). Rule: Notify recipient on likes, replies, and follows

tours.name: Moderate Reported Content
tours.outcome: Inappropriate content is hidden to keep the community safe

steps.title: Submit report on clip or comment (the report becomes pending). Rule: Anyone can report suspicious or abusive content
Review reported content (the report becomes reviewed). Rule: Moderator evaluates against community guidelines
Hide rule-breaking content (the clip becomes hidden). Rule: Rule-breaking clips and comments must be hidden from feeds and profiles
